sections.heading: 1. The Mulhim Service
body: Mulhim provides technology-based sports, fitness, training, nutrition, wellness, and performance tools.

bullets: Computer vision-based exercise and movement analysis.
Wellness, sleep, recovery, and lifestyle-related insights.
Personalized recommendations based on information provided by the user.
Other sports, wellness, fitness, nutrition, and performance features introduced by Mulhim.

body: We may introduce, update, improve, modify, limit, replace, or discontinue features as the Service develops.

sections.heading: 2. Fitness, Health and Medical Disclaimer
body: Mulhim is intended for sports, fitness, wellness, educational, and informational purposes.

Training plans, nutrition recommendations, AI-generated responses, exercise feedback, computer vision assessments, wellness insights, and other information provided through Mulhim are not substitutes for advice from a qualified physician, physiotherapist, dietitian, nutrition professional, certified trainer, or other appropriate professional.
You are responsible for determining whether an exercise, workout, training program, nutrition recommendation, or other activity is suitable for you.

You should consult an appropriate healthcare professional before starting or materially changing an exercise or nutrition program if you have an injury, health condition, physical limitation, pregnancy, unusual symptoms, or other health concerns.

You should immediately stop exercising and seek appropriate medical assistance if you experience symptoms such as severe pain, chest pain, fainting, significant dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or other concerning symptoms.
Mulhim must not be used for emergency medical situations.

sections.heading: 3. Artificial Intelligence

AI-generated information may occasionally be incomplete, inaccurate, inappropriate, or unsuitable for a particular individual or situation.

Mulhim does not guarantee that AI-generated recommendations, predictions, nutrition suggestions, training plans, exercise assessments, technique evaluations, or other automated outputs will always be accurate or error-free.
Users are responsible for applying reasonable judgment before acting on AI-generated information.
Mulhim must not be relied upon as the sole basis for medical, health, safety, or other high-impact decisions.

sections.heading: 7. Managing and Cancelling Subscriptions

Unless otherwise required by applicable law or Apple’s policies, cancellation does not immediately remove access to subscription features already paid for, and access may remain available until the end of the current subscription period.
